purpose: 元のHPの無骨さを残したドット絵風の方向見本。本番未反映。
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / original pixel-art direction proof.
USER FEEDBACK: They prefer the current homepage's RAW, STURDY, slightly awkward original character over the polished AI-looking illustrations. They want unmistakable character identity and a PIXEL-BASED RETRO feeling. NOT soft cute stock illustrations. This is a strong art-direction pivot.
Reference1 is the ACTUAL HOMEPAGE: PRIMARY guide for its flat 9-color palette, school buildings, wide schoolyard, understated quirky simplicity. Preserve its idiosyncratic visual identity instead of making a generic beautiful school.
Reference2 is the approved simplified four humanoid mascots, used ONLY for costume identity, NOT smooth rendering: preserve green/classroom note; orange/white headband/yellow flag; blue/side hair buns/yellow sash/mic; yellow/blue headband/white star/red cape. HUMAN-SHAPED, not animals, not realistic children.

Deliver ONE pixel-art concept sheet, landscape 3:2 composition, like an original early Japanese PC school-simulation game art bible. Top roughly 32% has four enlarged 32x40-ish pixel sprites on warm cream, spaced side by side. Lower 68% has a complete wide school-campus pixel-art map showing the same little characters and classmates at small gameplay scale. Separate top and bottom with a simple single dark pixel rule; no decorative panel chrome, no fake interface, NO text anywhere. Purpose: see distinctive characters up close and the world they belong to in one visual.

MANDATORY PIXEL LANGUAGE:
True-looking deliberate low-resolution PIXEL ART. Imagine a logical 384x256 pixel canvas enlarged with NEAREST NEIGHBOR to a large image. Every shape uses obviously visible square pixel clusters; diagonal lines are stair-steps, circles are stepped polygons. Tiny sprite faces 2-pixel black eyes and 2-3-pixel mouth. Consistent coarse pixel grid. No smooth vector curves, anti-alias halos, brush strokes, photographic surface, watercolor, grain, gradients, blur, glow, cinematic light, 3D, rounded app icon aesthetics or anime faces.
STRICT small palette inspired by HP: warm off-white #FCFBF7, charcoal #1C1C1A, sky #A9E1F5, grass #2FBA68, dark green #1F5C3F, brick-orange #D2552A, mustard #E8C547, school blue #3A6EA5, warm peach #F6D8B8. Limit to these 9 intentional colors; at most one restrained extra earth tone if truly needed. Flat fills, tiny single-pixel shadow clusters only. Avoid dense noisy dithering; broad empty flat regions matter.
Visual character should be a little stubborn and awkward in a LOVABLE way: blocky oversized hair caps, short squared limbs, tiny faces, strong dark silhouettes, one or two playful asymmetric pixels. Expertly economical pixels, not generic AI "retro pixel" painted detail. No Mario/Pokemon/Stardew-specific imagery or borrowed franchise sprites.

TOP FOUR LARGE SPRITES:
1 Green 学活くん: blocky near-square dark hair cap, peach face with black dot eyes and tiny crooked kind smile, green straight tunic with cream vertical placket, short legs, cream block shoes. One bent mitten hand up, other holds white square card with two green pixel lines. Dependable compact square silhouette.
2 Orange 行人: slightly narrower jaunty silhouette, black stepped hair under WHITE HEADBAND with two pixel-cluster tied ends, orange tunic with cream horizontal stripe, mustard triangular flag drawn in clear stepped pixels on dark pole, one foot kicked forward. Tiny lively face, NO huge glossy grin.
3 Blue 児童会ちゃん: peach face, two recognizable BLOCKY ROUND dark side hair buns, blue triangular-ish tunic, strong diagonal mustard sash drawn as stepped pixel band, short microphone with cream head, other hand out. Same tiny face grammar as others.
4 Yellow クラブマン: wide compact human-shaped sprite, blue forehead band, yellow tunic with WHITE pixel STAR outlined dark, simple brick-red cape splaying sideways in chunky staircase silhouette, both short arms up. Big identity through silhouette, small face, no forced baby-like proportions.
All four at same logical pixel scale and roughly 2-heads tall. No names/text rendered.

LOWER CAMPUS:
Wide distant school picture-map with broad flat sky strip, stepped white clouds, blue-roofed cream schoolhouse with mustard clock upper right, plain gym upper left, geometric dark green trees along simple school boundary, golden flat schoolyard. Mild top-down/three-quarter 2D tilemap perspective, classic 1990s Japanese school-simulation feel. Keep buildings recognizable from reference1, not a fantasy RPG village.
About 28-36 very small human-shaped sprite people distributed in four activity areas with open ground between:
Left classroom cutaway with green chalkboard, horseshoe of 5 desks, raised hand and little writing pupil; green mascot leads.
Middle-left sports day oval white track in stepped pixels, red event arch, sparse bunting, 3 runners, baton relay, cheering children, orange flag mascot.
Middle-right student council low platform and noticeboard, blue mic mascot, 6 classmates sitting facing toward stage at varied angles, one helps with board.
Right clubs: yellow caped mascot, small easel with simple flower, craft table with tiny toy plane, drum, two children watering small blocky flowerbed.
Supporting tiny recognizable school details: bench with red-white cap, water tap, school entrance, school bags, small potted plants. No clutter everywhere, not equally spaced cloned people.
Make little scene clusters memorable through gestures and spacing. Wide quiet warm sand areas preserve homepage's original unpolished but intentional graphic charm. Crisp small tiles and sprites, no naturalistic depth or painterly realism.
The resulting sheet must say "a distinctive original pixel school world" at first glance, not "an AI painting with a retro filter". Do not render typography, labels, titles, watermark or logos.
